About Me

I'm an undergraduate at Hunter College majoring in Human Biology on the pre-medical track. I hope to become a physician, with a particular interest in orthopedic surgery, sports medicine, and research that improves how patients recover and heal.

My experience spans innate immunity and infectious disease research, neuroHIV research, clinical volunteering, and training as an EMT. I enjoy connecting hands-on science with the people and problems that make the work meaningful.

Outside the lab and classroom, I enjoy soccer, photography, technology, and working on fun projects.

Current focus: Developing my research and clinical skills while excelling in my undergraduate pre-medical studies. Finishing my EMT training and becoming an EMT. Publishing my research.
